title: 南弗蘭克鐵礦
summary: 以皮爾巴拉鐵礦的新舊系統整合為例，研究連續運搬與產品配比。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A Pilbara iron-ore integration case examines continuous transport and product blending across linked facilities. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送；塊礦與粉礦分流前的入料均化；新舊設備不同停機窗口的緩衝
v31FocusEn: Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub; Feed homogenisation before lump and fines separation; Buffering different outage windows of new and existing equipment

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：南弗蘭克鐵礦
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: South Flank iron ore mine
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」與「塊礦與粉礦分流前的入料均化」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub" and "Feed homogenisation before lump and fines separation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub" is correct?
options: 輸送帶容量由堆積密度、料流截面與帶速決定；截面取決於槽形與裝載，不等於帶寬乘料高的任意矩形。
輸送帶速度正常就表示輸送噸數正常。
兩批礦石的品位只要做算術平均即可。
optionsEn: Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed.
Normal belt speed guarantees normal transported tonnage.
The arithmetic mean of two ore grades is always the blend grade.
quiz.explanation: 輸送帶容量由堆積密度、料流截面與帶速決定；截面取決於槽形與裝載，不等於帶寬乘料高的任意矩形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」如何決定「南弗蘭克鐵礦」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “South Flank iron ore mine”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「南弗蘭克鐵礦」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」。輸送帶容量由堆積密度、料流截面與帶速決定；截面取決於槽形與裝載，不等於帶寬乘料高的任意矩形。連續運搬仍受轉運點、落料分布與停機連鎖限制，平均容量不能證明整條系統無瓶頸。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using South Flank iron ore mine as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub. Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed. Cross-section depends on trough geometry and loading, not an arbitrary width-height rectangle. Transfer points, feed distribution and linked downtime still constrain continuous transport, so average capacity does not prove an unconstrained system. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：以皮爾巴拉鐵礦的新舊系統整合為例，研究連續運搬與產品配比。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。

quiz.question: 依「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」的模型 Q = 3600·ρb·A·v，輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = 3600·ρb·A·v for "Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
quiz.explanation: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v; with rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk, A = 0.22 m², v = 3.2 m/s the result is 4,562 t/h (synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 v 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v; with rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk, A = 0.22 m², v = 3.2 m/s the result is 4,562 t/h (synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise v by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5,018 t/h（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 5,018 t/h (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 4,562 t/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 v 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 4,562 t/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in v with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。
knowledge.textEn: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v; with rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk, A = 0.22 m², v = 3.2 m/s the result is 4,562 t/h (synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5,018 t/h（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 5,018 t/h (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為明示的合成教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are explicit synthetic teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

v31Model.meaningEn: Synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.

quiz.question: 要驗證「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

For belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows.
quiz.explanation: 針對「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用圖示列出每個轉運點的暫存量與容量；不讓學生靠近運轉輸送機做量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Diagram inventory and capacity at each transfer point; learners use datasets rather than approaching operating conveyors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed; full upstream loading with low downstream flow suggests transfer accumulation or measurement bias. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 針對「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。

Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently.

quiz.question: 在「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
兩批礦石的品位只要做算術平均即可。
optionsEn: In the scenario of belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The arithmetic mean of two ore grades is always the blend grade.
quiz.explanation: 在「新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In the scenario of belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed; full upstream loading with low downstream flow suggests transfer accumulation or measurement bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 新採區與既有處理樞紐的帶式輸送：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Belt transport linking a new mining area to an existing hub: failure diagnosis

steps.instructionEn: In the scenario of feed homogenisation before lump and fines separation, acceptable mean grade with unstable processing can arise from size segregation or omitted hardness contrasts; stratified sampling and size analysis discriminate between them. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “South Flank iron ore mine”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩批礦石的品位只要做算術平均即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The arithmetic mean of two ore grades is always the blend grade." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在「塊礦與粉礦分流前的入料均化」情境，平均品位合格但處理不穩定，可能是粗細粒偏析或未納入的硬度差；分層取樣與粒度分析可以區分兩者。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of feed homogenisation before lump and fines separation, acceptable mean grade with unstable processing can arise from size segregation or omitted hardness contrasts; stratified sampling and size analysis discriminate between them. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
